verdict: A no-op until the API key exists, and the key only reaches the review step.

findings.title: Pin the third-party opencode action to a commit
findings.scenario: Any same-repository pull request once ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set.
findings.consequence: anomalyco/opencode/github@latest is a mutable tag of a third-party action that runs with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, a pull-requests:write token and id-token:write; whoever controls that tag controls what runs with those secrets. Every other workflow here pins SHAs.
findings.fix: Pin to a reviewed commit SHA with a version comment, as deep-review.yml and ci.yml do, and let Dependabot propose updates.
